findings.title: Billable project count includes archived (soft-deleted) projects
findings.explanation: The query counts every row for the org and has no `archived_at IS NULL` filter. Projects are soft-deleted by setting `archived_at` (see `src/routes/projects.ts` and `activeProjectNames` in the same file). `docs/CONVENTIONS.md` says archived projects are excluded from every list, count, and bill. As written, organizations would be charged for projects they archived, so invoices would be overstated. Change the query to `SELECT count(*)::int AS n FROM projects WHERE org_id = $1 AND archived_at IS NULL`.

findings.title: No tests for a billing-critical function
findings.explanation: This function drives invoice amounts. Add a test covering an org with active and archived projects, and an org with no projects. A test of that kind would have caught the missing archived filter.

findings.title: Duplicated 'active project' definition
findings.explanation: `activeProjectNames` and this function each define 'active' separately. Consider sharing one predicate or constant, or deriving the count from a common helper, so the two cannot drift apart.
